This artificial Christmas tree adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The green and white finish and plastic and metal construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Crafted from flame-retardant PE and PVC materials, this tree helps prevent accidental fire hazards during the festive season. It creates a safe environment where families and pets can gather closely around the decorations without concern for heat or ignition risks.

Supported by a rustic fir wood base, the tree provides robust balance against accidental bumps and knocks in busy household areas. The rich natural timber texture elevates room aesthetics significantly beyond cold, basic metal stands often found on cheaper models.

With a height of 180 cm and a width of 108 cm, this tree serves as a breathtaking focal point for spacious living rooms or offices. Its impactful festive presence brings warm grandeur to high-ceiling foyers, retail displays, or large family gathering spaces.

5056589155957.sourceDescription:
Bring a softer, more contemporary feel to your festive decorating with this 5ft Light up Feather Pine Christmas Tree. Its feather-style branches create a striking tree-shaped silhouette, giving you a decorative Christmas feature without the dense appearance of a traditional artificial tree.

A total of 72 warm white LEDs are positioned throughout the tree, adding a gentle glow that highlights the unusual branch structure beautifully. At 1.5 metres tall, it has enough height to make an impact while its narrow 20cm x 20cm footprint makes it especially useful for areas where floor space is limited.

The tree is made from plastic around a supportive metal frame and stands on a sturdy base to help keep the display stable. It is mains powered and includes a generous 5m cable, giving you plenty of flexibility when choosing where to place it. A great choice for living rooms, hallways, conservatories, porches or festive entrance displays, this illuminated Christmas tree offers an eye-catching alternative to more conventional seasonal decorations.

Suitable for indoor and outdoor use (transformer must remain indoors)

72 Warm White LEDs
Height: 5ft (1.5m) Length approx 97cm Width approx: 62cm
Base Size: 20 x 20cm
Mains Powered with 5m Power Cable
DISTINCTIVE FEATHER PINE STYLE: Designed with open feather-effect branches for a lighter and more decorative appearance than a conventional artificial Christmas tree.
72 WARM WHITE LEDs: Pre-lit with warm white LEDs that brighten the branch structure and add a cosy seasonal glow to your Christmas display.
5FT TALL WITH SLIM FOOTPRINT: Standing 150cm tall while measuring just 20cm wide and 20cm deep, this Christmas tree delivers height without requiring a large amount of floor space.
MAINS POWERED WITH LONG LEAD: Comes with a generous 5m power cable, offering greater flexibility when positioning the tree around your home, porch or festive display area.
STURDY DISPLAY CONSTRUCTION: Made from plastic with a supportive metal frame and stable base. Suitable for creating illuminated Christmas displays indoors or outdoors.
Guarantee - 1 year

Christmas Decoration
This Christmas decoration adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The blue finish and polyester construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Snowflake Detail
Snowflake detailing adds a winter themed accent to the design. The pattern can be used alongside simpler decorations to vary the visual texture of a seasonal arrangement while keeping the display within a coordinated festive theme.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Product details
Material: Polyester. Colour: Blue. Stated size: 16cm. Quantity: 1 set.
Festive blue polyester decoration featuring intricate snowflake detailing for a defined winter aesthetic.
Compact 16cm size allows it to serve as a versatile accent piece within coordinated seasonal arrangements.
Designed to add visual texture and a focal point to Christmas displays when paired with simpler decor.
Flexible finishing touch that can be easily repositioned to refresh the look of your festive home decor.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Included: 1 set

Christmas Baubles
Add colour and detail to your Christmas tree with these decorative baubles. Their hanging format lets you spread the ornaments through the branches or combine them with other suitable festive displays for a coordinated seasonal arrangement.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Snowflake Detail
Snowflake detailing adds a winter themed accent to the design. The pattern can be used alongside simpler decorations to vary the visual texture of a seasonal arrangement while keeping the display within a coordinated festive theme.

Compact Format
The compact format helps the item fit into a smaller working or storage area. It is useful where you want the function close to hand without filling the whole space.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Material: Wood. Colour: Natural Wood. Stated size: 14 x 16 x 0.5 cm. Product weight: 0.1 kg. Quantity: 50 pack.

8941467526257.sourceDescription:
These brown velvet Christmas ornaments bring a warm, rich palette of brown, neutral and beige to the tree. The mixed tones are classic and minimalist, and they sit well together as a harmonious group or scattered between other decorations to break up a single colour scheme.

The velvet fabric is wrapped around a round plastic ball, with silk ribbons as an accent and pleats in the top fleece that give each piece a distinctive, slightly luxurious shape. Every ornament is handmade, sturdy and made to last through the season and beyond, and the set can be reused year after year rather than replaced.

At 80 mm (3.15 in) across, the ornaments are large enough to act as focal points on the tree. They are light in weight, so they will not pull the branches out of shape, and they are quick to hang. The shatterproof build means they will not break if they fall, which makes them a safer option in households with small children or pets.

Use them on the Christmas tree, on a wreath, along a garland, on the fireplace or around the home. They also work well for weddings, engagements, anniversaries and parties, and make a considered gift for the festive season. The set is an easy way to refresh a scheme you already have: the beige and neutral pieces blend with wooden, kraft and white decorations, while the brown pieces add depth where a tree otherwise looks flat. Nothing here is fragile, so the ornaments can be passed between rooms, packed loose and brought out again next December.

This Christmas decoration adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. Its multicoloured finish is easy to coordinate with the surrounding setting.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Christmas Decoration
This Christmas decoration adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Snowflake Detail
Snowflake detailing adds a winter themed accent to the design. The pattern can be used alongside simpler decorations to vary the visual texture of a seasonal arrangement while keeping the display within a coordinated festive theme.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

8956086258557.sourceDescription:
This two pack of Christmas tree cushion covers gives a sofa, armchair or bed an instant festive lift. Each cover measures 18 x 18 in, roughly 45 x 45 cm, and is made from 100% polyester with a soft, warm handle that suits winter rooms. The pack contains the covers only, so inserts or fillers are not included and you will need pads of the same size to fill them out.

A colour matched concealed zip runs along one edge, so the pad slides in easily and the cover sits flat and neat once closed, with no visible stitching across the front. The green tree design is printed to hold its detail through the season, and the fabric resists bleeding, fading and fraying, so the covers can be used outdoors as well as indoors. High temperature cutting seals the edges cleanly so the seams hold up to regular use.

Care is simple. Machine wash the covers in cold water on a gentle cycle, separately from other laundry, and do not bleach. They keep their shape and colour wash after wash, with no shrinking. Tumble dry on low and do not iron.

Mix them with plain or patterned cushions on living room sofas, dining chairs, beds or an office chair, and bring them out again each December for an easy seasonal change. The pair also works well in a hallway, on a window seat or in a spare bedroom that needs a touch of Christmas colour.
Guarantee - 1 month

This decorative iron Christmas wreath features a reindeer motif, accented with lifelike pine branches and red berries, offering a classic festive color palette and rich, layered detail. Its sturdy iron frame, combined with traditional Christmas elements,
 makes it an ideal choice for storefront windows, shop entrances, front doors, walls, or windows—perfect for bringing a festive atmosphere to both commercial and residential spaces.

Storefront windows and shop entrances
Front doors, back doors, and entryways
Walls, windows, and living rooms
Christmas parties and family gatherings
Holiday displays in shopping malls, cafés, and retail stores

 dimensions before ordering to ensure it fits your intended window, door, or wall space.
A Perfect Holiday Gift
An excellent gift for friends, family, or neighbors who love Christmas decor, shop styling, or rustic holiday aesthetics. It is also a wonderful choice for enhancing holiday displays in shops or decorating for family gatherings.

This Christmas garland adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The green finish and plastic construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Enjoy watching your DIY crystal Christmas tree take shape as every piece adds texture and sparkle, creating a charming crystal bead Christmas tree for the holiday season.
A Creative Escape from Everyday Stress: Give your hands an enjoyable project with this beaded DIY Christmas tree kit. Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

5059442204557.variantName: Blue Spruce Pot Grown Christmas Tree - Real Live Fresh Living Potted Plant - 5ft (150cm) · 本规格 / Selected: 5ft
5059442204557.sourceDescription:
Bring a living tree into your home for Christmas and enjoy the character that comes with choosing a pot-grown Blue Spruce. Its dense blue-green foliage and naturally conical shape create a full, well-balanced tree, while the slightly more rigid needles help the branches hold their shape beneath heavy lights and decorations. The unusual colouring sets it apart from other varieties, giving this real Christmas tree a distinctive appearance without needing to overdo the decorations.
DISTINCTIVE BLUE SPRUCE: Blue-green foliage and dense branching give this tree its characteristic appearance, with a naturally conical shape that looks full and well balanced. It also makes an attractive outdoor Christmas tree once the festive season has finished.
WHY CHOOSE POT-GROWN CHRISTMAS TREES?: This tree has been grown in its pot from the beginning, rather than being lifted from the ground and transferred into a container shortly before sale. Its roots have had time to develop within the pot as the tree has grown, without the disturbance of being dug up and moved. This makes it better suited to continuing its growth after Christmas, with a more established root system already growing in the pot. Unlike potted Christmas trees that have only recently been transferred from the ground, it can be kept outdoors and grown on after the festive season.
NEEDLES THAT HOLD WELL: Blue Spruce is known for its good needle retention, helping it maintain a full, fresh appearance throughout the Christmas period. This makes it a practical option for enjoying a real tree indoors without the rapid needle drop associated with some varieties.
YEAR-ROUND EVERGREEN TREES FOR GARDEN STRUCTURE: Blue Spruce keeps its blue-green foliage throughout the year, so its interest doesn't end when the Christmas decorations come down. Its evergreen character can add structure and colour to an outdoor space through every season.
CARE FOR YOUR LIVE POTTED CHRISTMAS TREES: Keep the compost moist while the tree is indoors, but avoid leaving it sitting in excess water. Position it away from radiators, fires, and other direct sources of heat, and keep its time indoors to the festive period rather than treating it like a permanent houseplant.
Please Note: Our pot grown trees are measured from the base of the pot to the tip of the tree.
Manufacturer guarantee: Statutory
